anchor_commits.subject: L12-ALPHA-001: bind loop evidence to authority receipts

scope.owned_layer: Approved-only tenant-scoped Alpha replication queue, authoritative research execution/readback, and ExperimentTask/ExperimentRun tenant lineage.
scope.not_changing: Registry review ownership, research-orchestrator route ownership, Compose/default runtime activation, hosted deployment, or live-capital authority.

research_authority.boundary: services/research/main.py FastAPI task/run routes and ResearchOrchestratorStore

proof: Queue rejects candidate, review, and missing approval bindings.
Worker rejects changed lifecycle, checksum, approval decision, approver, approval time, registry identity, and tenant during exact-ID readback.
The actual ReplicationGate accepts the canonical approved content only after the immutable approval envelope is independently verified.
The same strategy_spec_id can exist for two tenants without queue, task, or run collision.
Every claim, acknowledgement, failure, DLQ, and replay operation requires tenant_id.
Expired claims return to pending and the previous fencing token cannot acknowledge.
A simulated crash after authority persistence reclaims the lease and converges to the same deterministic task/run identity without duplicate authority state.
Duplicate registry discovery and controller restart converge to one queue item and one authority run.
Bounded failures enter DLQ; a duplicate replay_id is a no-op; one new replay generation produces exactly one new deterministic ExperimentRun.
The test dynamically loads services/research/main.py, calls its actual FastAPI routes with TestClient, and reads back the ResearchOrchestratorStore records.
Readback contains the exact nested ExperimentTask and completed ExperimentRun, production_activation=disabled, adapter=manual persistence transport, and producer_backend=replication_gate.

validation.command: PYTHONPATH=/tmp/l12-alpha-pydeps:. python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider services/research/alpha_replication services/research/experiment_orchestrator services/research/experiments services/research/tests/test_research_orchestrator_http_service.py

acceptance.statement: Only an approved reviewed immutable StrategySpec enters replication.
Discovery uses the canonical StrategySpec identifier and tenant-scoped keys.
Claims expire and stale work can be safely reclaimed or replayed.
Research authority stores a non-stub ExperimentTask and ExperimentRun.
Duplicate review, restart, failure, and DLQ replay are deterministic.

residuals.description: Upstream distillation must provide tenant-bound immutable approval metadata; this implementation fails closed until it does.
Compose/default runtime activation is deliberately outside this task; handoff_only remains a config alias whose execution semantics are authoritative.
ReplicationGate contains pre-existing datetime.utcnow() deprecation warnings with no behavioral impact.
